init_rnn: initialize a PyTorch RNN module's weights and biases with uniform distribution
init_rnn_cell: initialize a PyTorch RNNCell module's weights and biases with uniform distribution
init_linear: initialize a PyTorch Linear layer's weights and biases with uniform distribution
init_cont: initialize all weight and bias parameters in a PyTorch ModuleList container
make_mask: create a masked PyTorch tensor with specified indices set to a given value
